paragraphs: Insight Robotics is described on its homepage as a forestry-focused risk management company that mitigates threats by making sense of data. The wildfire detection system pairs EO/IR sensors with algorithms that detect wildfires within minutes of ignition. A separate aerial survey service is offered for early detection of natural and man-made threats.

The aerial surveys are offered to plantation and agroforestry owners. The homepage also names forest owners as the people the technologies are meant to help. A testimonial on that page comes from the Kelowna Fire Department in BC Canada, which reports its experience with the Insight Robotics camera.

The about page dates the first sale of the Wildfire Detection Robot to a client in Mainland China. The same page states deployment of over 100 Wildfire Detection Robots across 4 continents. Beyond the wildfire work, the pages describe an AI-Assisted Body Temperature Screening System applying the same technologies to screening in public areas.

quote.text: Insight Robotics is a forestry-focused risk management company, proactively mitigating threats by making sense of data
